name: mitotic arrest deficient 2 like 2

function.text: MAD2L2 encodes mitotic spindle assembly checkpoint protein MAD2B. Annotated molecular activities include transcription corepressor activity and RNA polymerase II-specific DNA-binding transcription factor binding. It participates in DNA repair and positive regulation of DNA-templated transcription.
